description.value: The Goldcorp Centre for the Arts is SFU's downtown Vancouver arts facility, located in the landmark Woodward's Building on West Hastings Street in the heart of the Downtown Eastside. It serves as a hub for theatre, performance, and arts education under Simon Fraser University's Woodwards campus umbrella, blending academic programming with community and professional arts activity. A touring cyclist visiting Vancouver's urban core would find this venue in a dense, walkable neighbourhood well-connected by cycling infrastructure.
